name: dk-agent-kit
description: Daniel Kaminski's agent kit: guardrail hooks and engineering skills adapted from mattpocock/skills, pstack and HumanLayer.

plugins.name: dk-guard
plugins.description: Guardrail hooks: blocks docker prune, unfiltered mass removal, pushes to main, plain force pushes and git clean -x; asks before rewriting pre-main, reading credential files or answering dk-gc's question; denies edits in the primary checkout of a repo that requires worktrees; opens each session with its repo, branch, PR, issue labels and databases; runs the repo's .claude/gate.sh before a turn with changes ends. Ships dk-pg, a throwaway Postgres per issue, and dk-gc, which removes what merged work left behind.

plugins.name: dk
plugins.description: Engineering skills: issue → worktree → TDD → review → verified PR into pre-main. /dk:triage, /dk:implement, /dk:implement-spec, /dk:to-spec, /dk:to-tickets, /dk:research-codebase, /dk:setup and more.
